comment: Fan-controller chip families exercised by tests/chip_families.rs and listed by scripts/cooling/fan-coverage.mjs. Quirks are modelled from the pinned LHM v0.9.6 sources and Linux hwmon driver docs; they are test stimuli, not hardware evidence.

families.name: Nuvoton NCT67xx/NCT5585D/NCT610xD, separate per-channel mode registers
families.source: LHM Nct677X: per-channel FAN_CONTROL_MODE_REG and FAN_PWM_COMMAND_REG; audited readback in NativeNctEvidence.

families.name: Nuvoton NCT6701D (owner board, ASUS PRIME X870-P WIFI)
families.source: LHM Nct677X 7-control layout; slower RPM settling as seen in the CHA_FAN2 calibration (COOLING_ACCEPTANCE.md).

families.name: Nuvoton NCT6683D/NCT6686D/NCT6687D(-R), EC-style shared mode register
families.source: LHM Nct677X: one manual-mode bitmask register for all controls; comment notes only fans 0, 1 and 3 respond on newer X870/Z890 boards.

families.name: ITE IT86xx/IT87xx with 8-bit extended PWM registers
families.source: LHM IT87XX: FAN_MAIN_CTRL_REG holds the output-mode bits of controls 0..2; the Gigabyte EC controller is disabled while writing.

families.name: ITE IT87xx with 7-bit PWM (no extended registers)
families.source: LHM IT87XX without _hasExtReg writes value >> 1 into a 7-bit PWM field.

families.name: Fintek F71878AD/F71889AD/F71882
families.source: LHM F718XX writes FAN_PWM_REG only; other Fintek chips report fans without controls. The chip's minimum-duty clamp is modelled as a limited duty range.

families.name: Winbond W83627/W83667
families.source: LHM W836XX: controls 0 and 1 share primary control-mode register 0x04 (per-channel bit masks).

families.name: ASUS embedded-controller sensors
families.source: LHM EmbeddedController and Linux asus-ec-sensors expose temperatures and fan RPM only.

families.name: Synthetic stress family: inverted PWM polarity, no readback
families.source: Not a real chip family; checks that duty encoding errors surface through the channel test instead of reaching runtime.
